query: INSERT INTO attendance_tombstones (org_id, employee_id, business_date, work_shift_id, deleted_by, reason) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (employee_id, business_date, COALESCE(work_shift_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) DO UPDATE SET deleted_by = EXCLUDED.deleted_by, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, created_at = now()
